Common questions

Who services Biogents mosquito traps in Austin?

GreenGuard USA services customer-owned Biogents traps (BG-Mosquitaire CO₂, BG-Mosquitaire, and BG-GAT) across the Austin metro. Service plans for traps you already own start at $60/month and include monthly on-site visits, trap inspection and cleaning, catch-bag emptying, attractant replacement, and placement tuning.

Can I get CO₂ tanks delivered for my Biogents trap?

Yes. GreenGuard delivers and exchanges 20 lb CO₂ tanks at your door on a monthly schedule, starting at $89.99/month. Your technician swaps the empty tank, verifies flow rate and connections, and inspects the trap on every visit. No trips to a welding supply store.

I bought a Biogents trap but it is not catching mosquitoes. Can you help?

Usually the issue is placement or CO₂ flow. Biogents traps work best in shaded, wind-protected spots between mosquito resting areas and your patio, with CO₂ running on a timer. We offer a free on-site assessment where we reposition the trap, check the CO₂ setup, and tune the attractant configuration.

Do Biogents traps need CO₂ to work?

The BG-Mosquitaire CO₂ performs dramatically better with CO₂, it mimics human breath, which is the primary cue mosquitoes hunt by. Field studies show CO₂-baited traps catch several times more host-seeking females. A 20 lb tank on an 8-hour daily timer lasts roughly 60 days.

What does trap service cost if I already own the equipment?

Own-trap service is $60/month per system for monthly maintenance, or $89.99/month if you add CO₂ tank delivery and exchange. Both include on-site visits, inspection, cleaning, attractant replacement, and placement tuning. Exact scope is confirmed at a free on-site assessment.

Where can I buy a Biogents BG-Mosquitaire CO₂ trap, and for how much?

GreenGuard USA sells the Biogents BG-Mosquitaire CO₂ trap for $299.99, which is $50 less than buying it direct from Biogents, shipped from Austin, TX. Buy it at greenguard-usa.com/shop/biogents-co2-trap. Local buyers can add CO₂ delivery and service.

What is the service area?

Austin and surrounding communities within about 40 miles: Westlake Hills, Lakeway, Bee Cave, Dripping Springs, Steiner Ranch, Round Rock, Cedar Park, Pflugerville, Leander, Liberty Hill, Georgetown, Kyle, and Buda.
